card.text: Ringed gas giant, sixth planet from the Sun.

introduction.text: Saturn's rings are billions of small chunks of ice and rock, reaching up to 282,000 km from the planet.

normal.title: Visible-light mosaic
normal.summary: Cloud bands assembled from archival visible-light images, not the clouds at the scene date.

ultraviolet.title: OPAL F225W map
ultraviolet.summary: 225 nm observations from August 2025; filled rows and added visible detail are not ultraviolet data.

methane.title: OPAL FQ889N map
methane.summary: 889 nm observations, gap-filled and sharpened with visible light; brightness does not measure methane.

thermal.title: Thermal-style cloud illustration
thermal.summary: Visible cloud patterns recolored to suggest a thermal view; the colors do not measure temperature.

cross-section.title: Interior structure model
cross-section.summary: Colored layers show the inferred interior; the boundaries follow a model, not measurements.
